assets.author: Petr Ganaj
assets.description: Green (pool/edible) frog half-submerged in shallow muddy water, head and eye above surface, ripples, soft bokeh; sharp and moody. Crop 9:16 around frog (centre-right).
assets.quality_note: Best 'eyes above water' shot found. Frog sharp, shallow DOF, muted brown-gold water - dramatic when graded. Only 1080p, so a 9:16 crop is ~608x1080 (upscaled ~1.8x to 1080x1920) - fine on phone, slightly soft.

assets.author: Kaffeesüchtig (https://pixabay.com/users/kaffeesüchtig-19168820/)
assets.description: Top-down macro of a vivid green-and-black spotted pool frog sitting in dark sunlit pond water among plants; nearly static.
assets.quality_note: Very sharp 4K, saturated, high contrast; excellent detail and crops cleanly to 9:16 (frog head left-of-centre). Static - no jump despite 'escape' tag.

assets.author: Chrizly_s
assets.description: Frog sitting in shallow pond water behind reeds, then dives/escapes under water (~4.4-5.3s) leaving a ripple/bubble ring.
assets.quality_note: WEAK. Real-time (not slow-mo), handheld phone look, frog partly obscured by grass blades, the 'jump' is a quick dive not a leap out of water. No genuine slow-motion frog-leaping-out-of-water clip exists on Pexels/Pixabay (all such clips found were Storyblocks/Getty/Envato/Uppbeat - not allowed). Suggest using the moment of the dive at speed, or simulate the 'jump out' with a fast push-in/whip transition from frog_closeup.

assets.author: Sayanbasakwildlifehindi (https://pixabay.com/users/sayanbasakwildlifehindi-51687614/)
assets.description: Bullfrog floating calmly in dark, glassy water beside lily pads; gentle ripples, reflections.
assets.quality_note: Cinematic and calm, dark water gives great mood/negative space for text. Frog sharp, sits in left third - crop 9:16 to the left. 38 MB (under 40).

assets.author: Şahin Doğdu
assets.description: Frog floating with eyes/head at the surface of a deep-green forest pond, shimmering reflections, lots of moody negative space above.
assets.quality_note: Very cinematic native 9:16 calm shot; frog is small in frame (lower-middle) - good as an establishing/'comfortable' shot, not a close-up.

assets.author: Max Griss
assets.description: Top-down view of a stainless pot at a full rolling boil on a black stove.
assets.quality_note: Clean, sharp, full rolling boil, native 9:16. Good 'too late' payoff shot.

assets.author: Evgenij Mikhailov
assets.description: Close-up into a stainless pot: tiny bubbles forming on the bottom as water starts to heat (pre-boil).
assets.quality_note: Sharp, shallow DOF, cool silver tones; perfect for 'slowly heating' beat (not a rolling boil).

assets.author: James Cheney
assets.description: Low-angle close-up of a gas burner under pan supports, dark kitchen; burner ignites in first ~1s and burns blue.
assets.quality_note: Cinematic, dark, shallow DOF, real ignition moment at start. Crop 9:16 to centre.

assets.author: Engin Akyurt
assets.description: Ring of blue gas flame floating in pure black.
assets.quality_note: Very graphic/minimal; flame ring ~880px wide so a 810px 9:16 crop clips its edges slightly (or scale down / use as background). Heavily compressed (1.1 MB) - fine since mostly black, check for banding.

assets.author: cottonbro studio
assets.description: Wispy white vapour/smoke swirling on a pure black background (studio).
assets.quality_note: Trimmed by us from the 40.8s original (5s-20s), re-encoded H.264 CRF18, audio removed. Technically smoke/vapour, reads as steam; ideal for screen-blend overlays and text backgrounds.
